items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results, and operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker/reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries. Do not retrieve credentials, change permissions or configuration, access private containers, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.
